description: Use this when a veteran asks what VA benefits they may qualify for. It returns programs to check, not an eligibility decision: only VA decides who qualifies for a VA benefit, and the agency that runs any other program listed decides for that one. The inputs are the veteran's circumstances as fixed choices, every one optional: service status, combined VA rating or no rating, whether compensation is paid, marriage and whether the spouse is on the award, SMC, TDIU, permanent and total or temporary 100% status, family and TRICARE, VA health care enrollment, a recent paid trip to VA care, a VA home loan, and an honorable discharge. It asks for no names, Social Security numbers, VA file numbers or narrative, and has no field for any. An answer that does not apply given earlier answers is ignored, and nextQuestion names the next question that does. Each program carries why it matched, the steps, its source URL and application URL, and for a spouse not yet on an award an estimated monthly increase when the answers allow one. It covers selected federal programs, not every benefit, and does not screen state or local programs. It reads no account data and stores nothing.

awardAlone.description: Whether the current award pays the Veteran alone rate, with no dependents.

compensation.description: Whether VA disability compensation is being paid.

family.description: Whether the veteran has a spouse or dependent child.

honorable.description: Whether the veteran was honorably discharged.

loan.description: Whether the veteran is buying or refinancing a home with a VA loan.

permanentTotal.description: Whether a VA decision describes the disability as permanent and total.

rating.description: Combined VA disability rating on the latest VA decision, in percent, or no_rating when VA has assigned none. A 0 rating is different from no_rating.

service.description: Whether the person has left military service (veteran) or is still serving (serving).

skipped.description: Question ids the veteran chose not to answer. An id listed here cannot also carry an answer.

smc.description: Whether VA pays special monthly compensation (SMC).

spouseOnAward.description: Whether the spouse is already included in the VA award as a dependent.

tdiu.description: Whether VA pays at the 100 percent rate through individual unemployability (TDIU).

temporaryTotal.description: Whether a 100 percent rating is temporary, for hospital care or recovery.

tricare.description: Whether the family member who needs health coverage is eligible for TRICARE.

trip.description: Whether the veteran paid to travel to VA or VA-approved care in the past 30 days.

vaCare.description: Whether the veteran is enrolled in VA health care.

name: find_veteran_benefits
title: Find veterans benefits to check
